models.note: subcircuit LM1117_N_3P3_TRANS from LM1117_N_3P3_TRANS.LIB; the maker says it covers: a transient model; the file states no scope. Its parameters give dropout against load current, a 1.2 A current limit, a 1.5 V under-voltage lockout, a start-up time, a supply-rejection pole and zero, and 1.5 mohm of output resistance. Xyce reads a copy changed only in spelling: line 47, C_U1_C1: IC= dropped, as ngspice ignores it without UIC; line 51, E_U1_E1: TABLE written with '=' and no outer parentheses
